# Draft:Whitehall Neighborhood, Delaware

----
Whitehall Neighborhood is a neighborhood near Middletown, Delaware, and is rather small. Its population isn't publicly known, but an estimate says around 600 people live in the neighborhood of Whitehall. It is located on Lorewood Grove Road, on route 76 that goes from Philadelphia down to Kent County, Delaware.
Famous People from Whitehall Neighborhood:
Joe Schmo (1910-1994)
References
Whitehall Magazine
New Castle News
This is a real neighborhood by the way.
